Maya (CS): Need a concise readout packet for Meridia before Tuesdays exec. Goal: one-slide snapshot + one-page activation playbook. Who can own which bits?

Ravi (Product): I'll take the performance snapshot and a short recommendation for a config health check.

Lina (CS Ops): I'll pull cohort metrics (activation %, time-to-first-success, drop-off by step). ETA tonight 9:30pm PT.

Samir (AM): Renewal status: medium risk, usage decline in two teams. I'll draft the renewal ask and timeline. Sales ops confirmed renewal date 2026-05-15.

Nora (SE): I can drop a 90s loom demo of the onboarding flow and own the technical risk note (SSO multi-tenant mapping edge case). Loom will be uploaded in a few mins.

Maya (CS): Proposed landing order: Executive snapshot (health + renewal flag); Top 3 activation plays (owners + timeline); Onboarding gaps & ETA; Usage trend + ask; Appendix: demo + infra notes. Keep language exec-friendly.

Lina (CS Ops): Quick data point: activation is 42% vs 65% target; biggest falloff at policy import step. I'll attach a small step chart to the folder.

Ravi (Product): Suggested play language: 1) Policy import workshop (1h)  owner: SE; 2) Champion coaching (2 sessions)  owner: CS; 3) Automated config health-check  owner: Product Ops. Feedback?

Samir (AM): Sounds good. I'll provide concession ranges and the renewal ask matrix by tonight 11pm. Also sending a short NPS quote praising "support responsiveness".

Nora (SE): Loom uploaded: https://loom.com/share/xyz-90s. SSO note uploaded to the folder.

Loom-bot: New recording uploaded by Nora (ID: 1725009888).

Maya (CS): Final owner list & deadlines: Maya: compile deck (due tomorrow 9am); Lina: cohort table & chart (due tonight 9:30pm); Nora: demo clip + infra note (done); Ravi: perf slide + health-check note (due 7am tomorrow); Samir: renewal ask + NPS snippet (due tonight 11pm).
